summary: Videotron Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of Quebecor Media, filed a Form 6-K containing its Management Discussion and Analysis for Q2 2026. The filing reports routine quarterly results: revenues of $1.23 billion (+3.3%), adjusted EBITDA of $643.5 million (+5.6%), and net income of $295.4 million (+15.9%). It also details ordinary financing activities: repayment of $500 million under a term credit facility, an additional $300 million repayment, a $100 million repayment on July 8, 2026, and establishment of a US$1.0 billion US commercial paper program. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews; this is a standard earnings and financing update for a foreign private issuer.
